title: Amélie (FCP 2026)
synopsis:
"Amelie" is a fanciful comedy about a young woman whose purpose in life is to orchestrate the lives of people around her in order to fix up their troubles. This leads her to invent all sorts of ideas to intervene in people's existence and to create a world of her own making. Her mission is rudely interrupted when she meets a strange, off-beat young man, Nino Quincampoix. Although fascinated by him, she plays hide-and-seek games, afraid of really opening up to this appealing young man.

 

Q/A with the director Jean-Pierre Jeunet after the screening on 17 NOVEMBER at PREMIERE ELEMENTS.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
《天使愛美麗》是一部關於一位年輕女性的幻想喜劇。她的生存目的是為了幫助身邊人解決生活中的煩惱。這使她想各種不同的方法去改變他們的命運，並在幻想中創造了一個她自己的世界。有一天，她遇見了尼諾，一個奇怪、與眾不同的男子。遇上尼諾改變了愛美麗的命運。雖然被尼諾深深吸引，但愛美麗仍與他玩捉迷藏遊戲，害怕向這位富吸引力的年輕人打開心扉。

 

11月17日 PREMIERE ELEMENTS場次放映後將設有導演Jean-Pierre Jeunet問答環節。
